premises.text: Central HVAC leaves rooms over/under conditioned; thermostat innovation alone is only part of the solution
premises.evidence_span: innovation has been focused on thermostat technology, but that is only part of the solution

premises.text: Wireless networked smart vents automatically redirect HVAC airflow to improve comfort and efficiency
premises.evidence_span: wirelessly networked home air vent that maximizes the comfort and efficiency of a home's central heating and cooling system by automatically redirecting the air

premises.text: Users install by swapping existing vents and set up via a web account; a Lifestyle Survey programs each vent's smart cycle without manual programming
A four-vent system can cut HVAC runtime up to 30% and eliminate hot/cold spots
premises.evidence_span: reduces HVAC run times by up to 30%

premises.text: Sell via e-commerce then retail, and partner with builders, HVAC suppliers, and utilities with subsidies
premises.evidence_span: leverage e-commerce partnerships to sell the KeenVent directly to consumers via the web

premises.text: Offer subscription and lifetime pricing for the four-vent system plus matching non-networked vents
premises.evidence_span: A four KeenVents system will be sold for $25 with a $4 monthly service fee

value.text: Maximize home HVAC comfort and efficiency with lower energy spend
value.evidence_span: maximizes the comfort and efficiency of a home's central heating and cooling system

secondary_value.evidence_span: average annual savings for our customers of one hundred and fifty to three hundred dollars

causal_links.evidence_span: eliminates uncomfortable hot or cold spots throughout the home
